sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
For other uses, see Shida (disambiguation).

Elhaza is a character introduced in Brave Frontier I as a unit known as Shida.

Elhaza serves as one of the seven Demonlords of Nogreth and one of the two leading commanders of Nogreth. He is also the main antagonist of Brave Frontier II.

sections.title: Brave Frontier I
sections.content:
As Shida, his name was briefly mentioned in Grand Quest: The End of an Empire when Myuze stated to have learned how to amplify her magical and life energies.

As Elhaza, he appears as a boss in The Curse Master.

sections.title: Motion Comic
sections.content:
Elhaza is first introduced when confronting troops at an otherworld named Extas, following an arrest of a professor named Gustaph Fabraska who was caught copying his own data that was sealed away. During this encounter, Elhaza and Shaiah exterminate the troops with Gustaph as the sole survivor. Elhaza walks towards Gustaph, telling him to follow along and that he has something important to do.

Sometime after the Akras Summoners' Hall was made aware of the events that took place in Extas, Elhaza looks through a spycam in a meeting room, presumably in the Demon Castle, and notes that the Summoners moved quicker than expected, but decides to leave them alone for now given the information he already has.

sections.title: Brave Frontier II
sections.content: Throughout most parts of the main story in Brave Frontier II, Elhaza made his appearance as the overarching major antagonist of the storyline. Most of the storyline progression, Elhaza is seen to be masked all the time he made an appearance. Until at a certain point of Chapter 9, he took off his mask and his true face is shown, which ultimately reveals that Elhaza is actually Shida.

sections.title: Chapter 8: Demon
sections.content: Elhaza made his only single and very brief appearance at extremely late, if not, at the end of the chapter, he is seen walking down to the subterranean parts of Sertavia; which later revealed as Underground Sertavia in Chapter 9.

sections.title: Chapter 9: Fate of Bonds
sections.content:
Elhaza appears in this chapter for most times by far as the direct major antagonist as well as the mastermind behind most of the events in the main story, especially at Sertavia. He encountered with the Summoner who accompanied with the soldiers, finding the soldiers coming together with the latter as nuisances getting in his way and proceeds to exterminate the Summoner and the soldiers without further delay. With everyone else killed but Summoner, Elhaza is unsurprised for his enemy's survival and starts to attack again, but Joshua came into timely intervention before assisting the Summoner in facing off against Elhaza. When the battle progresses, Elhaza understood of what he is sought for before deciding to eradicate Summoner and Joshua; yet the latter defends his attacks which forces him to use more powerful spell. But before he can do so, Shaiah appears through the gate she opened and takes his place with Elhaza retreats to the deeper part of Underground Sertavia. And as he went to the deeper parts of Underground Sertavia, he took off his mask in which this point has ultimately reveal that Elhaza is, in truth, Shida; telling Shaiah to himself that his ideal is soon coming true.

Shida is again encountered by the Summoner, Rin and their group at Liberation Ritual Site; they eventually stumbled into René, who is desperately trying to save her sister Hilda. Here, Argus, Lori, Grant and even king of Filarm Kingdom Morris are seen captured at the ritual site beneath Sertavia; driving Summoner and Rin to rescue them, only to be interfered by Shida. The latter came into René's assistance, while the others went to join in but Shida blocks their way by summoning powerful enemies to halt their progress in which the last keeps regenerating, leaving Rin and René to destroy the barrier protecting the mastermind behind the incident occurring in Sertavia. With the protection barrier destroyed, Shida finally steps up and releases the power he gathered though he claims that even it is incomplete, he is right to set his eyes on Sertavia for his very ultimate purpose. Both sides set onto the Soul Creation Realm, in order to clash each other in a decisive battle.

However, the Summoners are struggle to keep up against a fragment of power Shida used; the latter states that he chose to keep all of them alive for the moment of trial but realized they are not worthy for testing his powers and asks what happened to the Summoners of Old as he seen that Summoner, Rin, Sasha, Roy and Joshua alone are not enough. He became infuriated as Roy claims that they can still fight, preparing to eliminate them as they no longer have any use to him, but is stopped as someone cames into interference. Karl appears as he asks that if he alone is not enough due to other Summoners of Old are busy before unleashing his dragon demon's power, as Shida took the release of his power, he claims that this is the very moment he had yearned for.

In a brink of defeat, as Shida again seen the power of bonds with his own eyes, he found the interest in such power he researched. But before Summoner and Rin can land a final blow, the sword Lanford wielded suddenly plunges onto the ground in front of the three, to Shida's confusion and Rin's surprise; this eventually revealed the other Demonlords of Nogreth who were previously defeated appearing again: Gustaph and his creation Zaad, Baragan, Melfel, Lanford and Shaiah. With the final decision, Shida took Lanford's sword as the souls of other Demonlords fusing into the sword, channeling enormous energy into the weapon and granting ultimate power to Shida to the point he transformed into his penultimate form that releases terrorizing aura; nevertheless, Summoner and Rin have powerful comrades with them, and went onto the final battle which will decide the fate of Sertavia.

At the end, Shida is finally defeated, still clinging to what he had missed from his researches regarding the power of bonds, Karl reveals that he did not miss anything but Shida never realizes it from the beginning. Karl gives that should he truly understand the meaning of bonds and choose to cherish it dearly, such power would gave him greater power; but should that ever happen, Karl will not able to know the outcome of this battle or anything that could come from this and beyond. Without any power left inside him, Shida starts to disintegrate and fades away, thus marking his true death and the end of his goals he longed for.Incomplete
